validity_findings.observation: Synthetic derived_context is bound-then-parse tautology: headers_observed/body_observed/url_query already contain the exact expected header/body/query key and value (e.g., fam0 alias-0-0 derived_context headers_observed=Authorization:Bearer tok_0_0 equals hidden_expected expected_bound). The adapter's adopt-any-observed-key-not-in-registry logic copies observed keys verbatim into rewritten template, so 40/40 is trivial copy of parser output, not evidence of AX denoising or header/body extraction robustness.

claim_ceiling: Product kernel port of Frontier's audit-PASS rule-based critique-reconstruct adapter into src/spider/kernel.py reconstruct=True SURVIVES at synthetic-only ceiling: 40/40 pooled alias-OOD correct (Wilson [0.912,1.0], binomial p=1e-40 vs 0.10, McNemar p=6.98e-10 vs B-EXACT-MATCH 0/40), orthogonal 30/30 and mixed header+body+query 10/10 and held-out 9/9 and per-family 10/10 each with 0.0 false_accept (1.0 below B-VERBATIM-REPLAY 40/40, McNemar p=6.98e-10), exact-match 12/12 no regression, no-applicable UNKNOWN precision 1.0 FA 0.0, empty-registry 6/6 UNKNOWN, ECE 0.065 (binned 5, 3 empty bins disclosed) within 0.05 of Frontier proxy 0.080, confidence std 0.400 not constant, parity gap 0.0 within 0.10. Bounding: deterministic synthetic URL/header/body dict with tautological derived_context (observed state already encodes answer via bound-then-parse, no AX tree, no header/body extraction noise), viewport 1280x720 probe only (Chromium+CDP viable example.com 15 AX nodes), zero live WebShop/ALFWorld tasks, zero real SPA heterogeneity, zero learned GRPO, and unavailable RAG-embed/instruction baselines (TFIDF only). C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE therefore SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST at product-kernel level bounded to genuine reconstruction on the 3 orthogonal families plus mixed composition with calibrated UNKNOWN, but does not advance to VALIDATED for live browser or PRODUCT_CORE without live replication, learned stability, and end-to-end browser/network economics at scale.
